integrity: The primary v1 preprint was inspected at the normal-curvature evolution identity, the non-preservation criterion, and the complete compact-torus calculation. The new pointwise derivative follows from those published identities, while the profile maximization and global energy coefficient are derived independently and replayed symbolically from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The result is an initial-time quantitative refinement for the compact torus with profile (2+cos(theta),sin(theta)). It does not describe the nonlinear later-time location of curvature maxima and does not extend the closed constants to arbitrary profile curves.
title: Exact first-order normal-curvature production in Kunikawa's compact torus
